name: Dhampur

registry.custodian: Board of Revenue, Uttar Pradesh / Government of Uttar Pradesh
registry.evidence: The first-party digitization dashboard identifies Bijnor > Dhampur and reports revenue-village, linked-Bhunaksha, and georeferencing counts; the Board of Revenue portal links Bhulekh/Bhu-Naksha services.

queries.query: Dhampur Uttar Pradesh official cadastral parcel map Bijnor Bhulekh GIS
queries.result: Found first-party UP Bhulekh digitization dashboard and Bhu-Naksha viewer references. The dashboard identifies Bijnor/Dhampur; current bundle inspection exposed https://upbhunaksha.gov.in/bhunakshaserver as the public map API base.

queries.query: धामपुर उत्तर प्रदेश आधिकारिक भू नक्शा खसरा नक्शा बिजनौर
queries.result: Found the first-party Uttar Pradesh Board of Revenue/Bhulekh land-records portal and official Hindi-language dashboard/viewer references. Search results also identify Dhampur as a Bijnor tehsil and cite the public Bhu-Naksha service.

parcelEvidence.nativeIdentityPolicy: No polygon was retained; no source-specific attribute set was copied.
parcelEvidence.crs: The current Bhunaksha JavaScript configuration uses the service response CRS for map extents and advertises UTM-style EPSG:32643/32644 handling in editing code; no parcel geometry response was accepted without a valid extent.
parcelEvidence.geometryResult: No usable parcel geometry obtained. A POST to /bhunakshaserver/MapInfo/getVVVVExtentGeoref with gisLevels=09,134,00716 returned HTTP 200 and gisCode 0913400716 but xmin/ymin/xmax/ymax all 0.0. This is a bounded service/UI failure, not evidence of citywide absence.

notes: Research packet only; not source integration or runtime admission. Exact WUP point preserved in latitude/longitude order. Dhampur city point is not assumed to equal any revenue-village centroid or parcel.
